metadata.goal: Analyze the vessel movement patterns along a long and relatively straight passage.
metadata.dataset_description: Eighteen constructed passages by one cargo vessel, including normal status transitions and three temporary-anchor exceptions.
metadata.source_note: Danish maritime geography is used as context; the visible trajectories and attributes are constructed derived data.

insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df=pd.read_csv(dataset_path); df['gap']=abs((df.heading-df.cog+180)%360-180); print(df[df.nav_status.eq('At anchor')][['trajectory_id','gap','sog_knots']])

insights: The vessel maintains stable heading and COG and nearly straight trajectories over long portions of the passage, with only limited directional changes during the main transit phase.
Each passage generally includes a status transition phase, during which the vessel changes from restricted manoeuvrability to under way using engine, accompanied by a smooth increase in speed.
In a few cases, COG does not respond to a heading change, resulting in temporary anchoring for restarting.
